decisions.reason: As a multi-model handle family in the firm's core business, B embodies visible development and portfolio investment, so management is likely to justify continuing it unless there is clear evidence of lasting failure.

C is close to the established design-led offer, but as a single design rather than a broader system family it is easier to remove than B or F, even though sunk development and brand commitment still favor persistence.

F fits the firm's announced move toward digital building organization and likely required substantial technical and certification investment, so escalation of commitment strongly favors retaining it and attributing any weak results to temporary market factors.
